newsitem.title: USA: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to watch - Oct 11.
newsitem.headline: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to watch - Oct 11.

text.p: * Knogo North America Inc and Video Sentry agreed to a stock-swap merger. Knogo closed at 8-15/16 on Thursday and Video Sentry closed at 4-3/8.
* Cascade Communications Corp late on Thursday reported third quarter earnings of $0.21 a share, up from $0.07 a year earlier. Cascade closed at 86-1/2 but fell 6-1/2 in after-hours activity.
* Ascend Communications Inc reported third quarter earnings of $0.20 a share after an $0.11 merger charge, versus $0.06 a year earlier. Ascend closed at 64-3/8 but rose 1-1/8 in after-hours trading.

* Great Western Financial Corp declined comment on a Business Week report quoting an unnamed investment banker as saying a large money center bank would approach Great Western with a friendly merger deal. Great Western closed at 27-1/8.
* Minntech said its second quarter results will be weaker than expected. It closed at 13-1/2.

* Pharmacia & Upjohn Inc said it expects third quarter earnings per share before charges to be close to the pro-forma $0.44 reported a year ago. Disappointment over the forecast sent shares falling three points to 38-3/8 in London.
